use_case: AI quality inspection on processing lines: smart camera on the Line 2 packager that checks seals and verifies that each label's product name, allergen statement, and lot code match the job
vendor_or_model: Packaging machine vendor (computer vision models trained by the vendor; inference on the camera; retraining in the vendor cloud)
source_evidence: EV-011 (purchase order and commissioning record); EV-036 (Production Supervisor interview); EV-052 (pilot results and update history)
data_categories: Pack images; label text and lot codes; incidental images of workers' gloved hands (no audio)
human_in_the_loop: AI can only reject packs to a bin; the Production Supervisor decides every reject; the first-label check and second-person template check stay in place; operators can bypass at any time
applicable_laws: 9 CFR 418.2 and 418.3 for label errors that reach commerce; 9 CFR 417.4(a)(3)(i) if it changes or replaces a check; FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims); worker-monitoring use prohibited by company decision
status: Pilot on Line 2 since 2026-06-15; approved with conditions 2026-08-31; snack sticks excluded from the seal check until retrained

use_case: Cold-chain anomaly alerts: the monitoring service flags unusual temperature patterns (for example a door left open or a failing compressor) before a fixed alarm limit is reached
vendor_or_model: Cold-chain monitoring vendor (built-in machine learning feature)
source_evidence: EV-006 (dashboard settings); EV-044 (vendor documentation: on by default)
data_categories: Temperature readings; alert history (no personal data)
human_in_the_loop: Early warning only; fixed temperature alarms and manual readings remain the monitoring record; the Production Supervisor decides any action
applicable_laws: None specific; 9 CFR 417.2(c)(4) applies to the CCP monitoring the feature sits beside, not to the feature
status: In production (enabled by default in the vendor service)

use_case: Public generative AI chatbots used by the Office Manager to draft customer emails and price letters
source_evidence: EV-035 (Office Manager interview); EV-043 (staff AI question)
data_categories: Risk of formulations, label templates, customer lists, or employee data being pasted
